title: Girl and Man Fishing in Motorboat, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from around the 1940s capturing a young girl and a man in a small motorboat on a body of water. The girl is seated in the boat holding a tin can near a bowl, looking toward the photographer, while the man behind her wears a sun helmet and operates a fishing rod. An early outboard motor is visible in the foreground with arid hills in the distant background.
